title: Certified but Private: Scalable Zero-Knowledge Proofs for Neural Network Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2608.17070v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With the growing deployment of machine learning models, formal guarantees of the robustness and fairness of these models have become increasingly important in safety-critical and legal-compliance settings. However, model parameters are often commercial secrets that cannot be disclosed to auditors or end users. To this end, we present PANDA, a scalable system that uses zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) to prove the robustness and fairness properties of a model without revealing its private parameters. PANDA is built on top of CROWN, an efficient robustness certification framework that is used in many state-of-the-art formal verification tools for neural networks. The core contribution of PANDA is a novel algorithm for proving linear relaxation bounds for non-linear activation layers, yielding simple, lightweight proofs. Remarkably, our system can generate proofs of local robustness for neural networks with more than 2.9M parameters in 5 minute

translated_title: 已认证但私密：神经网络保证的可扩展零知识证明
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17070v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着机器学习模型的日益部署，在安全关键和合规环境中，对这些模型的鲁棒性和公平性的形式保证变得越来越重要。然而，模型参数通常是商业机密，不能向审计员或最终用户披露。为此，我们提出了PANDA，一个可扩展的系统，使用零知识证明（ZKPs）来证明模型的鲁棒性和公平性属性，而不泄露其私有参数。PANDA构建在CROWN之上，CROWN是一种高效的鲁棒性认证框架，被许多最先进的神经网络形式验证工具使用。PANDA的核心贡献是一种新颖的算法，用于证明非线性激活层的线性松弛界限，生成简单、轻量级的证明。值得注意的是，我们的系统能在5分钟内为超过290万参数的神经网络生成局部鲁棒性证明。
tldr: PANDA系统通过新颖的线性松弛算法，利用零知识证明在5分钟内为290万参数的神经网络生成鲁棒性证明，同时保护模型参数隐私。
en_tdlr: PANDA system generates robustness proofs for neural networks with 2.9M parameters in 5 minutes using zero-knowledge proofs via a novel linear relaxation algorithm, preserving model parameter privacy.
